depth_justification: The copilot is fully mode-collapsed: every turn just echoes the app description verbatim hundreds of times with a single hallucinated tag [P2.D3], never engaging with any specific disclosure (gamified streaks, age-blind absolute threshold, opt-in clinician escalation, missing child 'my data' view). It is entirely generic and degenerate, never referencing THIS developer's choices or any applicable regulation/article.
actionability_justification: There is zero actionable content: no questions, no recommendations, no recipes, and the requested structured risk report degenerates into the same repeated sentence under a single [P1.D2] tag. A developer could implement nothing from this output.
